name: ETS variant transcription factor 6
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ETV6 encodes transcription factor ETV6. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to thrombocytopenia 5 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Infantile fibrosarcoma; Papillary thyroid carcinoma; Secretory carcinoma of skin. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: ETV6 encodes transcription factor ETV6. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Functional annotations also associate the protein with DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific.
